chapter: Billy and De De Pierce, Al Hirt tour
title: Working with Billy and De De Pierce
summary: Billy and De De were good to work with but fought; a fight cost them a job, and they worked on Dumaine near Kingfish.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Well, that's right by home plate there. Yeah. Where you used to go and meet. Right. So many different guys I want to ask you about. You never did tell me much about Billy and the Dee and John. Well, I can tell you they were pretty nice fellas, people to work with.

They were pretty good to work with. And we worked together quite a long while. All they told us was during that time. They both used to fight the battle and it was all the trouble with them. Of course, he was the cause of us to lose the job out there by the club out there. He had a cross here with a trumpet. Busts of heads. We lost the job there. Hmm. You had a bus of trumpet?
No, you hear it with the bell. The edge of the bell.

And this guy, you say, the boss, he comes to and says, what happened Billy? Oh, when I was coming to work, I fell off the streetcar. He said, no, you're lying. I said, because I was looking at you when you were coming here. There wasn't nothing wrong with you with me. I was being brought with me, gushing out of him. So he said, suppose they could suspend him for two weeks. Give him two weeks suspension. We went with our golf. Told the waiters to come back there. Tell us don't come back no more. We all lost the job. That boy was tough, rough doing that time. Do you know what I mean? But outside of that, they were pretty good people who were good. Pretty good. And so funny how they just went up to the world, just take me up. When we was in St. Louis, that's where we met when we were going to Mexico. They met us in St. Louis. They walked around there. East one of them got $6,000 tied around here. They wasted $6,000 in trust in the bank. Folks, I had been doing DD for years, man. Both of them. In fact, I've been building with them, working on Charles and Dekayla and Dumaine. That was your top-notch club out there, where they were working at.

I have to kill that Dumaine right on the corner. I forget the name of that club. But we were working out towards the next street down in St. Louis. St. Philip. We were working there close to St. Philip Street.
Mama was right next to us.
That's where they were working at, Kingfish. All right. Kingfish.
I live two blocks from there, but I can't keep it straight because it's all changed.
I was there this morning, right?
I think they got a supply of business, all they call it.
